content:
Thanks again for meeting with me. I’m Levario and I'm building an open-source MCP proof-search system that generates and verifies Lean formalizations while preserving proof-search and training traces. I would like to begin with one small, source-grounded Statlib contribution rather than submitting a large generated development. Based on our discussion, I’m especially interested in foundational multiple-testing definitions and the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure. I’d appreciate a small initial target and guidance on the preferred source, definitions, and level of generality.

The tool: https://github.com/Mnehmos/llm-driven-proof-search/tree/main
